trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL certificate and internal CA certificate with auto-renewal
trello.desc: The wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com expires on September 1st, and the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh expires two weeks after the public one. Both must be renewed and deployed by August 22nd to provide a buffer before expiration. Steps: (1) Renew the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com. (2) Renew the internal CA cert for the service mesh. (3) Deploy both certificates to the load balancers in a single change window. (4) Move both certificates onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward, eliminating the annual manual renewal process. Acceptance criteria: Both certificates are renewed and deployed before August 22nd; both are managed by cert-manager with auto-renewal enabled; no certificate-related outages occur during the change window.

trello.name: Implement PDF export feature for reports including demo GIF for changelog
trello.desc: Customers have been requesting the ability to export reports as PDFs. This is a single deliverable with two halves, both handled by Aisha. Backend: render the report to PDF using headless Chrome. Frontend: add an export button and a progress/loading state, since large reports take a few seconds to generate. Additionally, as part of finishing the feature, record a short demo GIF of the export functionality for marketing to use in the changelog. Target completion is end of month. Acceptance criteria: Users can click an export button on a report and receive a downloaded PDF; a progress state is shown during generation for large reports; a short demo GIF is recorded and provided to marketing for the changelog; feature is complete by end of month.

trello.name: Restore staging environment parity with production and set up ongoing drift detection
trello.desc: The staging environment is currently three migrations behind production, causing QA issues. This task has two parts. Part 1 (immediate): Run the three pending migrations on staging to bring it to parity with production today. Part 2 (ongoing): Write a nightly job that diffs the staging database schema against the production schema and posts a message to the infra channel if they diverge. Acceptance criteria: The three pending migrations are applied to staging today; staging schema matches production schema; a nightly diff job is deployed and running; the job posts to the infra channel when divergence is detected.
